central_baseline: u=v=0 produces exact uniform bitstrings for every parameter vector; K is Binomial(16,1/2)

campaigns.input: conditional IQP Born machine: Hamming-weight encoder of encoder_formula, shared 4x4 lattice layer (this file)

selection: mean exact full TVD over the eight development conditions (score J); reporting conditions excluded from training, checkpoint, start and configuration selection

training.loss: sampled squared conditional MMD with step mask refresh; kernel slot fixed per update
training.condition_allocation: independent uniform draw over the nine fitting conditions per update
training.target_pool_policy: one pool per (stage, repeat), shared by every trial, start and campaign at that stage and repeat; independent between stages and repeats

search_space.source: Curie-Weiss follow-up search space (cw_followup_config.candidate, independent_unconditional family) plus the one-body initialization mean

init_scale.meaning: standard deviation of the zero-mean Gaussian on every initial phase (input conditioning) or every entry of w_0 (diagonal conditioning)

one_body_mean.meaning: added to the 16 one-body initial phases (input conditioning) or the 16 one-body entries of w_0 (diagonal conditioning); all condition-dependent rows start at zero

kernel.ordered_pair: w2<=w3; repetitions allowed; single categorical over the 45 ordered pairs
kernel.bandwidth_mapping: sigma=[-2*log(1-2*w/16)]^(-1/2), w counts the identity mask

search.random_sampler: Optuna 5.0.0 RandomSampler seeded by the structured seed ('sampler', campaign, 'random'); all 60 proposals frozen before any fit
search.tpe_condition: the TPE phase runs only if timing measured on the random phase shows that all five campaigns, including confirmation, final fits and reporting, finish within the compute window; the decision uses wall-clock timing only, not scores
search.trial_score: mean over repeats of the selected development score J; a numerical failure in any repeat gives J=1

confirmation.shortlist: three lowest screening J over all screening trials, ties by trial id; exact duplicate configurations count once
confirmation.winner: lowest mean confirmation J, ties by trial id

final_fitting.retention: all ten selected repeats; no best-repeat selection

fit_selection.procedure: per repeat, the minimum J over all checkpoint steps of all starts
fit_selection.ties: earliest checkpoint step, then lowest start index

randomness.seed: first four bytes of sha256(canonical JSON [master_seed, namespace, *keys])
randomness.pairing: streams and pools are independent of trial and campaign, so the five campaigns and all trials share pools and fit streams at the same stage, repeat and start; stages are independent

limitations: Exploratory task-informed family and encoder; development selection uses exact target probabilities.
No necessity or advantage claim for the forty-parameter layer.
